description: Master-corpus acquisition, deduplication, partitioning and blind-control constants.

source_query.note: 01 §8F: the exact PubMed query is frozen in the data manifest at acquisition; no query has been issued.

publication_date_floor.note: 01 §8F. Publication date only; indexing date is not accepted as a substitute.

split_seed.note: 00 §6.2. Partitions do not change across training seeds.

exact_duplicate_key.note: 00 §6.2: deduplicate by normalized exact text hash.

near_duplicate_shingle_size.note: 00 §6.2 mandates near-duplicate filtering before split assignment but fixes no shingle size; the frozen value is set at acquisition against the real corpus.

near_duplicate_threshold.note: Jaccard threshold. Same status as the shingle size: required, not yet calibrated against real text.

natural_member_eval.note: 00 §6.3 NATURAL_MEMBER_EVAL. Disjoint from the calibration subset.

blind_control_ci_method.note: 00 §6.4 requires a 95% CI but fixes no estimator; the algorithm is frozen here before any real corpus is opened. Resampling uses the accepted Block B resampler.

blind_control_ci_replicates.note: Bootstrap replicates for the blind-control CI. Frozen with the method.

blind_control_ci_seed.note: Resampling seed for the blind-control CI. Distinct from the 00 §6.4 CV seeds 6104/6105 so the CI draw cannot reuse a fold assignment.

blind_control_label_balance_rule.note: 00 §6.4 requires balanced labels. NATURAL_MEMBER_EVAL and EVAL_NONMEMBERS are equal by construction, so unequal input means an upstream fault; the controller refuses and balancing must be explicit and recorded.

blind_control_regularisation.note: 00 §6.4 fixes L2-regularised logistic regression but not C; frozen before the real control runs.
